title: KaliBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Cybersecurity Tool Use on Kali Linux with Runtime-Free Verifiable Rewards
abstract: arXiv:2610.02206v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs are increasingly applied to cybersecurity workflows, where they are expected to translate analysts' intent into tool invocations. However, existing evaluations focus on knowledge-based assessments or end-to-end agentic tasks, and do not directly measure LLMs' ability to generate executable commands for real-world cybersecurity tools. This gap is critical because cybersecurity operations rely on strict command-line interfaces (CLIs), where minor syntax errors, incorrect flag--value bindings, or argument misordering can invalidate execution. We introduce KaliBench, a fine-grained benchmark and dataset for natural-language--to--CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query--command pairs spanning 1,642 tools across 23 capability dimensions and 5 security phases. translated_title: KaliBench：一个基于Kali Linux的网络安全工具使用细粒度基准测试，具有无需运行时的可验证奖励
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正越来越多地被应用于网络安全工作流程中，人们期望它们能够将分析师的意图转化为工具调用。然而，现有的评估主要侧重于基于知识的测试或端到端的智能体任务，并未直接衡量大语言模型为现实世界网络安全工具生成可执行命令的能力。这一差距至关重要，因为网络安全操作依赖于严格的命令行界面（CLI），轻微的语法错误、错误的标志-值绑定或参数顺序错误都可能导致执行失效。我们提出了KaliBench，这是一个面向Kali Linux上自然语言到CLI转换的细粒度基准测试和数据集，包含8,504对查询-命令对，涵盖1,642个工具、23个能力维度和5个安全阶段。KaliBench通过基于文档的流水线构建，采用确定性规范化处理和别名感知评估，实现了精确且可复现的评估。
tldr: KaliBench是一个针对Kali Linux上自然语言到命令行转换的细粒度基准测试，包含8,504对查询-命令、覆盖1,642个工具，通过确定性规范化和别名感知评估，实现对大语言模型生成可执行网络安全命令能力的精确且可复现的衡量。
en_tdlr: KaliBench is a fine-grained benchmark for natural-language-to-CLI translation on Kali Linux, comprising 8,504 query-command pairs across 1,642 tools, enabling precise and reproducible evaluation of LLMs' ability to generate executable cybersecurity commands through deterministic canonicalization and alias-aware assessment.
